userProfile.title: UserProfile
userProfile.description: Authenticated billionaire player profile and cloud wallet summary.

userId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the user.

cashBalance.description: Current virtual liquid cash balance in USD.

streakDays.description: Consecutive daily reward streak in Asia/Kathmandu timezone.

lastClaimDateKathmandu.description: Last daily reward claim date in yyyy-MM-dd format (Asia/Kathmandu).

registrationStatus.description: Server-validated registration status proving the user completed registration.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the profile was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

userHolding.title: UserHolding
userHolding.description: A user's owned asset position with quantity, weighted-average cost basis, verified photo metadata, and online price.

assetId.description: Permanent unique asset ID from the 400-asset catalogue.

name.description: Full display name of the asset.

quantity.description: Owned quantity (whole or fractional depending on divisibility).

averageCostBasis.description: Weighted-average purchase price per unit in USD.

imageUrl.description: Verified online HTTPS photograph URL for the asset.

imageSource.description: Authoritative museum, manufacturer, or editorial CDN source of the photo.

licenseInfo.description: License terms for the asset photograph.

verificationStatus.description: Verification status of the online asset photograph.

onlinePriceUsd.description: Latest synchronized online reference valuation in USD.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the holding was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the holding was updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

syncedAsset.title: SyncedAsset
syncedAsset.description: Cloud-synchronized asset record storing verified real-world photograph metadata and online market valuation.

assetId.description: Unique asset ID from the 400-asset catalogue.

name.description: Full display name of the asset.

imageUrl.description: Primary verified online HTTPS photograph URL.

verificationStatus.description: Verification state of the asset photograph.

onlinePriceUsd.description: Synchronized real-world online market valuation in USD.

priceSource.description: Authorized online market data provider source.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the asset record was created via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp when the asset record was last updated via FieldValue.serverTimestamp().

tradeOrder.title: TradeOrder
tradeOrder.description: Completed or open trade order record scoped to a user.

executionPrice.description: Unit execution or limit price in USD.

totalAmount.description: Total buy cost or net sell proceeds in USD.

realizedPnL.description: Realized profit or loss on SELL orders.

/users/{userId}.description: Stores each authenticated user's profile, liquid cash balance, net worth, and daily claim state.

/users/{userId}/holdings/{assetId}.description: Stores each authenticated user's asset holdings keyed by assetId, including verified image metadata and online valuation.

/users/{userId}/assets/{assetId}.description: Stores cloud-synchronized asset records with imageUrl, imageSource, licenseInfo, verificationStatus, onlinePriceUsd, and updatedAt.

/users/{userId}/orders/{orderId}.description: Stores each authenticated user's executed and open trade orders.
